summary: This plugin provides DeepSeek Harness with ROS2 diagnostics and debugging capabilities, covering inspection of nodes, topics, services, parameters, TF, graph, and bag info, and enabling build/install/parameter/recording workflows plus optional GUI observation and interaction after user approval.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily a ROS2 diagnostics and debugging assistant integrated with DeepSeek Harness: it exposes many ROS2 inspection commands for read-only troubleshooting and adds optional, approval-gated management actions, with an additional layer for launching/observing ROS GUIs and automating local GUI interaction. This user-facing scope is robot/system debugging rather than general-purpose generation or content tooling, so its primary category is testing-debugging with conservative high-risk handling due to command execution and local automation capabilities.
